# `make` targets

Run `make help` for the same list in the terminal. Variables such as `CHUNKS=8` or `ID=<call_id>` are noted in each description.

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `make help` | show this help |
| `make up` | build + start the whole stack in hardened mode |
| `make down` | stop everything (keeps the database volume) |
| `make reset` | stop everything and DELETE all state (db volume, queues) |
| `make wait` | block until the API answers |
| `make logs` | follow worker + beat logs (JSON) |
| `make ps` | show containers |
| `make trigger` | run one 5-chunk call end-to-end and watch it finish (CHUNKS=8 to change) |
| `make trigger-retry` | recoverable faults: chunk 1 fails twice (backoff retry), chunk 3 hangs (soft time limit). Ends COMPLETED |
| `make trigger-bad` | chunk 2 has corrupt audio (PermanentError): call ends FAILED, message parked in the DLQ (make dlq) |
| `make trigger-poison` | chunk 2 kills its own process every time (poison pill): requeued until the attempts cap, then DLQ |
| `make trigger-bug` | chunk 2 raises an unexpected exception: task FAILURE -> chord error callback -> call FAILED |
| `make status` | list recent calls |
| `make events` | audit trail of a call: make events ID=<call_id> |
| `make dlq` | peek at the dead-letter queue |
| `make config` | show the reliability settings in effect |
| `make test-spot` | Spot-eviction chaos test against HARDENED Celery (expect: call completes) |
| `make test-spot-default` | same test against Celery's STOCK defaults (expect: work lost, call stuck until the police act) |
| `make test-prefetch` | prefetch_multiplier=4 vs 1: watch workers hoard messages vs share fairly |
| `make lint` | check Python import ordering with Ruff |
| `make lint-fix` | automatically organize Python imports with Ruff |
| `make viz-check` | validate the visualizer against the database (submits calls; ~3 min, or CALLS=4 CHUNKS=2) |
| `make bench-viz` | measure the visualizer's cost: ingestion rate, many runs, one huge run (no broker needed) |
| `make ui` | build the visualizer UI into celery_viz/ui_dist (in a Node container; nothing installed on the host) |
| `make ui-test` | UI typecheck + unit tests (in a Node container) |
| `make test` | Python unit tests, run against the working tree (not the copy baked into the image) |
| `make docs` | regenerate docs/reference/* from the code, config and compose file |
| `make docs-check` | fail if generated docs are stale or hand-written docs mention things that no longer exist |
| `make police-now` | run one police sweep immediately instead of waiting for beat |
| `make flower` | open Flower |
| `make rabbitmq` | open the RabbitMQ management UI |
| `make psql` | psql shell into PostgreSQL |
